inputs_and_scaling.centroid: Input cache xyz1_normalized[A0,3] is the hard-mass centroid in prepared isotropic normalized xyz=(xyz_mm-bbox_min_mm)/L
inputs_and_scaling.volume_channel: v1[i]=mass1_mm3[i]/mean(mass1_mm3)=A0*mass1_mm3[i]/sum(mass0_mm3); dimensionless input-only relative aggregate volume, no fitting, clipping or logarithm. Mass is the predeclared positive corner-volume/10 incidence proxy, not exact curved volume or FE mass.
inputs_and_scaling.descriptor47: D1=concat(R01@F0_masked, xyz1_normalized, v1[:,None]); [A0,47]. R01 is the stored hard mass restriction, not smoothed P01.T. BC-homogeneous ownership preserves exact role meaning; floating row-sum tolerances are reported without reclassifying roles by thresholds.
inputs_and_scaling.fixed_maps: Use complete predeclared CSR R01/R12, P01/P12 and quotient W1/W2. No topK, threshold pruning, nearest reassignment or runtime graph reconstruction. P uses omega2/3, two Jacobi passes and isolated identity rows.

single_fixed_architecture.levels: Original nodes N0 -> connected fine aggregates A0(target2048,safety4096) -> coarse aggregates A1(target128,safety512)
single_fixed_architecture.query: Compute Q0=tanh(nonaffine_LN32(P01@Y1_2)) over original nodes once per active CAD per step, then gather original node IDs preserving duplicates/order. No unsupported CSR index_select, no dense N0x2048 or nnz x32 expansion.
single_fixed_architecture.modules: One embedding Linear47to32 and four independent Linear64to32 modules ordered coarse0,coarse1,fine0,fine1. No learned attention, new head, extra token branch, radius or width alternatives.
single_fixed_architecture.normalization: Every LN32 has elementwise_affine=false and eps=1e-5; all six normalization uses have zero trainable parameters. FP32 context tensors follow the common high/TF32 policy; native decoder arithmetic remains unchanged.
single_fixed_architecture.neighbor_operator: A1_neighbors=diag(W1*1)^-1@W1 and A2_neighbors=diag(W2*1)^-1@W2, using positive real cut-edge multiplicities; degree-zero rows are identity. These are message operators, distinct from the common Jacobi prolongation J.
single_fixed_architecture.sole_pair_difference: message_mode=self_only|neighbors selects only A1/A2. All inputs, restrictions, prolongations, module order/weights, constants, nonlinearities and budgets are identical. Both execute all four Linear64to32 modules, even in self-only.
single_fixed_architecture.hierarchy_receptive_limit: Two updates per quotient level plus the shared fixed restrictions/prolongations give a bounded hierarchy-mediated receptive field. They do not guarantee a global mesh solve or propagation across the graph diameter. The unchanged PointNet global32 remains a global summary in both modes.
single_fixed_architecture.existing_spatial_mixing: Self-only still contains connected aggregate pooling, actual coarse geometry and positive P01/P12 neighbor smoothing. It is not a no-topology or no-neighbor-information control; the pair isolates learned neighbor-message aggregation conditional on those common operations.

field_and_initialization.implementation: Use a new isolated nn.Module: existing PointNetBCRoleEncoder for global32, the new topology encoder, and the existing frozen SplitHashBandwidthDecoder in coarse8 mode. Do not construct an old Query/HashBandwidth full field and leave an unused query_projection stored or falsely describe the new path as Gaussian.
field_and_initialization.condition_layout: Raw43 + topology32 + global32 =Identity107; masked Hash24 +Identity107 +thirteen ones =public Network144, output9. Global BCactual cloud, material/local13/Euclidean5, width128x2 and load-linear signed basis remain unchanged.
field_and_initialization.full_parameter_estimate: Frozen public encoding7733632 +network36864 +PointNet16800 +topology9856 =7797152. Source-derived estimate only; actual implementation must count public tensors. The old Gaussian projection2080 is replaced, not retained.
field_and_initialization.ctor_order: Instantiate global PointNet, embedding, coarse0,coarse1,fine0,fine1, then the same split decoder in exactly the same order for both modes; reset seed2026 before each complete model. No mode-dependent module construction or input-size-dependent initialization.
field_and_initialization.matching: Record hashes of every named trainable initial tensor, native encoding/network separately, total counts, and common nonlearned coarse8 mask. Natural predictions may differ because A differs; initial parameter equality is the requirement.
field_and_initialization.effective_capacity: Equal stored parameters and same initialization do not make the effective function classes identical. Neighbor mode can use information from adjacent aggregates that self-only cannot obtain through the message layers. No comparison to an old Gaussian or three-channel model is a matched baseline.
field_and_initialization.query_API: encode_context(clouds5,masks,topology_inputs_in_explicit_CAD_order)->bundle(global32,Y1_2,fixed_maps). forward/response_basis receive explicit original node_indices and cad_index as well as xyz/features/alpha. No coordinate-nearest query, case-ID embedding or implicit mutable cache.
field_and_initialization.per_step: Keep four ordered case slots, deduplicate at most4 CADs, recompute their differentiable topology/global contexts and full-node Q once each per step; gather nodes/corners using explicit original IDs. Never detach or reuse trainable contexts across optimizer updates.
field_and_initialization.evaluation: Under no_grad encode the4 CAD contexts once, query original arange node IDs in chunks, compute basis9 once per CAD and combine its three known loads; reuse predictions for the same physical corner-P1/recovery metrics.
field_and_initialization.future_continuity: This pilot queries original nodes only; the future all10 curved-TETRA10 continuous adapter is a separate unexecuted proposal. No nearest interpolation or continuous whole-field claim.

cost_estimates_not_measurements.dense_trainable_math: At2048/128 and width32: embedding plus four message linears is about24million forward FLOPs per CAD (~96million for4), excluding sparse aggregates, nonlinearity and backward. Safety4096/512 increases this; actual hierarchy counts control cost.
cost_estimates_not_measurements.token_memory: One4CAD level-token buffer at2048/128 requires about1.06MiB FP32; multiple layers/backward retain more. Query32 at51200 occurrences is6.25MiB.
cost_estimates_not_measurements.prolongation_query: Cost scales with selected P01 nnz times32. The input-plan average<=64 nnz/row does not bound every selected row or the incidence-biased sampled-row average. At observed mean64, weighted query mixing is about0.21GFLOPs, not a promised runtime.
cost_estimates_not_measurements.bounded_working_memory: Prefer chunked sparse row multiplication/gather-scatter. Do not materialize all nnz times32 features at once:51200*64*32 FP32 would be~400MiB. No dense N0xA0 matrix or automatic sparse clipping.
cost_estimates_not_measurements.runtime_reporting: Measure actual context embedding/messages/prolongation/query time, full step elapsed, CPU/GPU peak memory and cache bytes within root's formally authorized first step/pilot. No added GPU profile or speed promise here.

clear_gain_gate.status: Frozen before first pilot fit; all4conditions required, no threshold adjustment
clear_gain_gate.comparator: Neighbors versus its newly initialized matched self-only at the same fixed1000 endpoint on the same12 TRAIN cases
all_required: Recovered allnode P1 case-mean relativeL2 reduction (self-neighbors)/self >=0.20
U worst-case deterioration neighbors-self <=0.02 in relativeL2 units (2 percentage points)
Absolute physical recovered-P1 error does not worsen: mean over12 cases of sqrt(Frobenius error energy/Nnodes) for neighbors <=self-only
clear_gain_gate.denominators: Allnode u relativeL2 and recovered-P1 relativeL2 use each case's same physical truth denominator; physical P1 RMS uses sum over nodes of symmetric Frobenius squared error divided by node count, tensor shear weight2, without division by6. Gate absolute P1 means physical error RMS, not sampled normalized squared loss.
clear_gain_gate.zero_control_error: If the self-only relative error is zero, the corresponding relative-reduction percentage is undefined; report it and do not silently call the gain gate passed. No epsilon-based new weighting choice.
clear_gain_gate.why: Require useful fitting improvement in both displacement and derivative quality, while guarding worst displacement and physical derivative error. The existing P1/u tradeoff makes a one-metric pass insufficient. No whole-CAD transfer or physical causality conclusion follows from a4TRAIN pilot.
clear_gain_gate.if_fail: Do not expand steps,width,neighbors or smooth radius automatically; root interprets the single result and selects a bounded next task
clear_gain_gate.if_pass: Root interprets the single result and selects one next bounded task. No automatic40TRAIN/5VAL, secondseed or final/DIA evaluation.

scientific_limits: This is4TRAIN fitting utility, not validation or generalization evidence.
Shared R/P already mix topology; self-only is conditional control of learned message aggregation, not no-topology baseline.
P1 is displacement-derived corner FE proxy with full-node incidence recovery, not solver GT strain.
Coarse8 bandwidth/geometry/BC/global conditions are common; only message A1/A2 differ.
Positive constant reproduction does not establish rigid/affine elasticity accuracy, curved-map validity or off-node continuity.
